description: §19.16.3 rule 3 — a failable deferred call handled in place with `!{}` is legal and its handler runs at exit: `defer closeAll() !{ ::Busy :> … }` compiles clean; at exit closeAll fails with Busy and the in-place handler records it: trace = "work;close-failed;".
rationale: §19.16.3 rule 3: the canonical in-place handling is an inline `!{}` handler; the `!{}` binds to the deferred call (not to the `defer`), so it runs when the deferred body runs — at the block's exit.
